title: Sources of Power
coreMove: Separate durable sources of power from temporary surprise or copied tactics.
sourcePressure: The chapter asks where strategic force comes from before leverage is applied: recurring, durable conditions that change the contest rather than temporary tricks or copied surface moves. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A source of power is any advantage, resource, or clever trick.
